scope_note: CPU profile focuses all historical storage calls, potentially including bounded observer probes, not just this client. Fractions are CPU sample shares, not wall latency decomposition.
primary_bottleneck: Contract metadata recovery performs two complete key-specific scans of an unindexed hot tail, decoding every unrelated packed RLP row; cold missing-key searches repeatedly open and decompress history headers before confirming accessor misses.
compression_conclusion: No evidence new V8 paged .idx compression is the second-scale primary cause: no samples in page reader; hot changeset codec, cold generic codec, key-search backend and segment search code are byte-identical to precompact eaae18c8. New .idx has a separately measured microsecond cost in the prior 16-file paired corpus, so not claiming zero overhead.

latent_correctness_issue.trigger: target < indexed watermark < head; no indexed candidate, but matching mutation exists in unindexed tail
latent_correctness_issue.baseline_repro: baseline-tail-repro.log: FAIL, returned nil instead of block 3; full collector control returned block 3

prototype_scope: Go overlays only: fix premature first-seek return and reuse target account generation for storage metadata; no production sources modified or deployed. 52 targeted top-level tests passed.

component_experiment.claim_limit: Isolates metadata work, not whole RPC speed. Correcting the tail omission may add previously skipped reads; must combine with cold-first bounds and grouped tail lookups before claiming net speedup.

recommended_order: Fix first-seek tail omission and add boundary regression matrix.
Reuse exact target generation for contract metadata; prefer earliest cold result and bound or skip later hot search without losing tx/seq ordering.
Group exact-key tail lookups or add a bounded MVCC-aware shared tail directory/cache; do not decode unrelated rows separately for each key; propagate cancellation.
Check accessor key presence before opening/decompressing .seg; reuse bounded immutable metadata across request pins.
Only then optimize .idx reader/header reuse and stage batch scheduling using matched workload; no format rollback, database reset, or memory increase is justified by these samples.
production_actions: Read-only RPC and bounded pprof; diagnostic evidence files only. No restart, deployment, configuration or database mutation.
